thread:
Jordan: Quick sync — ACME pilot kickoff questions. Need to lock POC acceptance criteria and the eval set before next Friday.
Maya: copy. what are the must-have success metrics from product side?
Jordan: two top-line items: (1) precision on top-3 answers >= 85% on business QAs, (2) 95th percentile latency < 450ms for 512-token prompts on dedicated.
Tom: for precision, do we use binary correct/incorrect or graded score?
Maya: graded is better for their use case (partial credit for near-matches). propose a 0-2 score (0 wrong, 1 partly right, 2 correct).
Rach: agree. also add failure-mode counts: hallucinations, PII leaks, policy blocks. we need per-type thresholds.
Jordan: good point. propose regression gates: new model must not increase hallucination rate by >1.5x and must not drop mean score by >3 points on our 0-2 scale.
Maya: that sounds reasonable. i'll draft the eval harness config. quick Q on golden set size — ACME expects 500 examples but legal is asking for redaction & anonymization proofs. thoughts?
Tom: 500 is fine but split into 3 tiers: 100 critical (hand-reviewed by customer), 200 common, 200 edge-cases. critical set should be locked and used as the canary.
Jordan: pricing question from procurement: if we run the 2-week POC on Dedicated, do we bill for reserved capacity or burst? they want a short trial discount.
Rach: sales note — we can offer a time-limited pilot rate: 50% off reserved base for first 30 days, then transition to pay-as-you-go if they don't commit. need finance sign-off but we've done variations before.
Maya: ops-bot, can you confirm what telemetry we can include in the POC report (token counts, p99 latency, per-route cost)?
ops-bot: automatic metrics available: total tokens, avg tokens/req, p50/p90/p99 latency, error rate, per-model cost estimate. Can export CSV + trace IDs.
Maya: perfect. for the eval harness i'll include these exports + a small sample of traces for any failing examples.
Jordan: on security questionnaire — ACME wants proof of KMS integration and SOC2 certs. Rach, can you own that ask?
Rach: on it. i'll attach SOC2 cert and a KMS integration diagram. might need redaction steps documented for the golden set.
Tom: implementation detail for scoring: i'll add a lightweight scoring script. snippet: 
```
# score.py (pseudo)
for example in goldset:
  answer = model.generate(example.prompt)
  score = grader.compare(answer, example.gold)  # returns 0/1/2
  record(answer, score, latency_ms)
```
I'll add hooks for tags (hallucination, pii).
Maya: timeline check — draft harness by Tue, golden sets uploaded by Wed, run baseline & new-model runs Thu-Fri, results + short deck Monday to ACME.
Jordan: sounds good. last blocker: will ACME allow us to keep anonymized golden set after the pilot? otherwise we can't run future regressions.
Rach: legal follow-up needed. i'll flag retention terms in the SOW.
Maya: i'll prepare the harness README with scoring rubric, JSONL format, and exact gating thresholds. will ping for review. :thumbsup:
Jordan: thanks team. i'll update the customer thread with the acceptance criteria and pilot pricing proposal.
Rach: ping me before you send procurement details.
Maya: uploaded draft harness config to the shared drive: https://redwood.example.com/drive/acme/poc/harness-config (private link)
Tom: putting the scoring script in repo: https://git.redwood/sales/acme-poc/tree/eval (branch: maya/harness)
Jordan: closing loop — next sync Thu 10am PT. if anything changes, drop a note here. :calendar:
